workflow: User reviews and accepts WEBENCH legal terms; authenticate only if the service requires it.
Generate the exact-part design. Record service version, design identifier, requirements and complete chosen BOM.
Inspect which electrical/thermal analyses the exact part supports. No features assumed solely from general product marketing.
Preserve default manufacturer design as a reference; modify a separate design to native passive values where the UI permits.
If exact passives, enable network or load behavior cannot be represented, label result as a reference comparison, not a simulation of this board.
Run supported startup, steady state, line/load transients and frequency-response checks. Retain raw exports and convergence/model limits where provided.
Compare fixed baseline against 4.75/5.25 V and justified load/capacitance corners; assess numeric margins against source-qualified consumer limits.
Keep full-board thermal, boot, EMI/EMC and other IC currents unverified; review scored evidence only after applicable results are obtained.
